rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only recovery student needs independent, direction-diverse labels under the strongest confirmed local controller.

control: Exact bend-rebound visual ZIP SHA 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49 as inherited driver and integrity anchor.
falsifier: Invalid samples/action/label, missing hash, invalid actions, or insufficient independent/right-direction coverage.
